## Type of Change

## Verification Checklist

Please complete the following checklist before requesting a review:

- [ ] I have executed `flutter analyze` locally and confirmed **0 errors and 0 warnings**.
- [ ] I have verified local Node.js backend syntax (`node --check`) and API functionality.
- [ ] I have tested this build on a target platform (Windows Desktop / Web / Mobile).
- [ ] I have included screenshots or screen recordings for any visual UI changes.
- [ ] I have updated relevant documentation in `Docs/` or `README.md` if APIs or configurations were changed.
- [ ] I have preserved the mandatory brand watermark attribution (*"Powered by Famalth • FAMALTH LYNX Ecosystem"*).
